purpose: Distinguish source-detection selection from flux-measurement bias without treating the first-pass MAST source catalog as Cepheid photometry.
sealedInputs: The 142 published author IDs and coordinates
The even-ID development and odd-ID validation split
The +0.02 arcsec RA*cos(dec), -0.08 arcsec declination transform learned separately in each band
The official calibrated exposures and data-quality masks
Magnitude, colour, period, local-background, and component strata defined before validation outcomes

workPackages.objective: Create a target-first ledger independent of source detection.
workPackages.method: Place one row at every frozen author coordinate and attach band, exposure, detector, local background, data-quality state, nearest catalogue source, and forced-flux result.
workPackages.deliverable: A 142-row identity crosswalk for each band with explicit unmatched states.
workPackages.pass: No row is deleted because a source catalogue omitted it; every coordinate maps through a documented astrometric transform.
workPackages.failure: Ambiguous coordinate transforms or detector-edge and mask states cannot be resolved without outcome-dependent choices.
workPackages.next: Split ambiguous transforms into preregistered sensitivity branches rather than choosing the best-fitting branch.

workPackages.objective: Estimate detection and photometric error separately.
workPackages.method: Inject PSF-shaped stars spanning the real magnitude, colour, background, and crowding strata, then run the unchanged catalogue and forced-photometry pipelines.
workPackages.deliverable: Inclusion-probability and magnitude-residual curves with binomial, calibration, PSF, and background uncertainty.
workPackages.pass: Both independent pipelines agree within 0.02 in inclusion probability and 0.01 mag in median residual over supported strata.
workPackages.failure: Injected residuals fail to cover real-source residuals or unsupported strata dominate a component.
workPackages.next: Report a partial-identification interval over supported strata and do not extrapolate into unsupported backgrounds.

workPackages.objective: Test whether detection conditioning can move the component contrast.
workPackages.method: Compare complete-case, forced-measurement, and injection-weighted component contrasts on the sealed validation set while preserving shared-anchor covariance.
workPackages.deliverable: One preregistered contrast table and a branch decision.
workPackages.pass: Both independent reductions keep every contrast shift below 0.01 mag and agree on its uncertainty interval.
workPackages.failure: Any admissible correction exceeds 0.01 mag, changes sign across reductions, or depends on a few high-weight targets.
workPackages.next: Localize the discrepancy to detection, flux bias, astrometry, or unsupported transport before any H0 refit.

uncertaintyBudget.control: Disjoint development split and transform sensitivity grid
Simultaneous binomial intervals by background and magnitude
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Effective injections below the preregistered precision target

uncertaintyBudget.control: Exposure-specific PSFs, detector masks, and residual diagnostics
uncertaintyBudget.stop: Injected and real residual distributions are incompatible

uncertaintyBudget.control: Preserve ancestor covariance in all contrasts
uncertaintyBudget.stop: A common term is averaged down as independent noise

safetyAndEthics: Uses public astronomical data and simulated source injections. It makes no claim about unpublished author intent and preserves unmatched identities rather than reverse-engineering hidden selection rules.
claimBoundary: Passing PHOST-FORCED-1 would constrain detection-conditioned bias for the tested data and strata. It would not recover the missing 154-to-144-to-142 selection reasons, individual phase corrections, or a current global-H0 likelihood.
